title: Projective-line models and discrete-scalar trace comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Use the canonical Chern data of [def-sp-tower-class-chern], strict ringed systems of [def-sp-tower-class-systems], tensor/Hom twists of [def-sp-tower-class-twisting], and projective splitting construction of [def-sp-tower-class-projective]. A projective-line model for $f:X\to S$ is an isomorphism $e:X\simeq\mathbf P^1_S$ over $S$, together with the normalized geometric adjunction, coefficient and line pullbacks and the canonical projection mate. Its section class is $c_1(e^*\mathcal O(1))$. Define its splitting by the unit and the untwisted Chern adjunct, and its trace, when the splitting is invertible, by positive twisting, shifting by two, inversion and the second projection with dual-line evaluation. Restriction to strict discrete constant $\mathbf Z_\ell$-module towers retains all underlying groups, maps, restrictions and transitions, and $z$ acts at level $n$ by the residue of $z$ modulo $\ell^{n+1}$. Use the completed coefficients and total derived functors of [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit] and the twists of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. Define exact restriction/direct-image comparisons by their common-derived-unit equation, and direct-image/limit comparisons by the derived-unit equation induced by $\operatorname{limit.post}$. The auxiliary cone and shift maps are the actual derived-unit and shift-comparison composites.
